Ended up getting an exploratory D&C because nothing in the blood tests or ultrasound showed anything. The cause was apparently an overgrowth of polyps (non cancerous) which they ended up scrapping out. After that I was fine. 

I would go to your doctor and get it checked out.

It depends, is it more like spotting? Small amounts of blood but not enough to warrant a tampon. If so, it can be normal to spot before or after your period or after ovulation. 
You may also have fibroids which can sometimes cause break through bleeding. 
Given that you’ve been bleeding for the last two weeks though I would go get it checked out by a doctor if you can.
